title: German Windhund bomber-tracking technology

tellings.quote: there was one I seem to remember called the German name was Windhund,

plain: Wartime Germany is said to have had a technology for tracking enemy bombers, one version of which was called Windhund, German for "greyhound". Nick Cook, an aviation journalist, mentions it to Michels from memory ("I seem to remember") and names no source. It matters because it is part of his larger account of how advanced Germany's secret wartime technology was.
